data.name: Vinith
data.gender_notes: Vinith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vinith is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vinayak' which means 'God of Victory' or 'God of Wisdom'. It is also a popular name in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Kannada languages. The name Vinith carries the meaning “God of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Vinith usually hope their child will grow to embody god of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vinith is a powerful name that represents the victory of the spirit over the material world. It is believed to bring strength, courage, and wisdom to the one who bears this name. It is also a name of Lord Ganesha, the god of wisdom and the remover of obstacles.
data.etymology: Vinith belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vinith total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vinith holds a significant cultural impact in Hindu society, particularly among the devotees of Lord Ganesha. Lord Ganesha, also known as Lord Vinayak, is the elephant-headed God, widely revered and worshipped as the remover of obstacles. The name Vinith is synonymous with victory and wisdom, qualities that are highly valued in all aspects of life. In various Hindu religious texts, Lord Vinayak is depicted as victorious, powerful, and profoundly wise.
